slots.notes: Project case-study photography for the 3 sticky stacking ProjectCards. Each card has a two-up image grid: a left column (md:w-[40%]) of two stacked object-cover images and a right column (md:w-[60%]) of one tall self-stretch object-cover image, for 3 images per card x 3 cards = 9 sockets total. Native prompt hardcodes 9 separate higgs.ai/CloudFront .webp URLs (sockets to fill, not values to keep). All are object-cover inside large rounded-[40-60px] frames so any crop works, but heights are fixed via clamp(): left image 1 clamp(130px,16vw,230px), left image 2 clamp(160px,22vw,340px), and the right image self-stretches to fill both, so portrait-ish or flexible-crop art reads best. Shown on a #0C0C0C card, so mid/high-key imagery keeps the layout from going flat.

Single Google Font 'Kanit' (weights 300-900) used for everything: the giant gradient-clipped 'Project' heading and per-card number (font-black uppercase, clamp up to 160px / 140px), the card Category label (font-medium uppercase), the project Name (font-light tracking-wide), and the 'Live Project' button (font-medium uppercase tracking-widest). Native declaration is font-family:'Kanit',sans-serif on html/body, loaded via Google Fonts <link>. Replacement should carry weights 300 through 900 and tolerate uppercase tracking-widest plus very-large display sizes, since the heading scale and card layout assume a condensed-friendly grotesque.

mechanic: Three position:sticky, top-pinned ProjectCards on a #0C0C0C rounded-top section that, driven by framer-motion useScroll over the section, stack and scale-down (earlier cards shrink toward 0.94/0.97, the last stays at 1) into a layered deck as you scroll, each card revealing a 40/60 two-column image grid.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS + framer-motion (useScroll/useTransform/motion, motion.create for the reusable FadeIn), with the Google Font 'Kanit' loaded via <link> and the .hero-heading gradient text-clip authored in plain CSS.
reskinNotes: Colors and motion constants are baked into markup, not tokens: the heading gradient is a fixed linear-gradient(180deg,#646973,#BBCCD7) in a .hero-heading CSS rule using -webkit-background-clip:text, and the light tint #D7E2EA is hardcoded inline via Tailwind arbitrary values (text-[#D7E2EA], border #D7E2EA 2px, bg-[#D7E2EA]/10 and /20 hover/active states) on every card border, number, label, name and the Live Project button, so retinting means editing CSS/className strings rather than config. All copy is hardcoded in JSX: the 'Project' heading, the three project numbers/categories (Client/Personal)/names (Nextlevel Studio, Aura Brand Identity, Solaris Digital), and the literal 'Live Project' button label (all hrefs are '#'). The stacking effect depends on literal numeric constants -- per-card top:index*28px offset, targetScale = 1 - (totalCards-1-index)*0.03, sticky top 24/32px, 85vh wrapper height, max-width 1760px -- which must scale with any change to card count. Heading and number use clamp()-based fluid sizes (up to 160px/140px) and tracking-tight/tracking-widest, so a wider replacement font will shift the giant display type and card header layout.
